column1: # What a geode holds, by role (never by type id): `geode::open` draws a prize
# per slot of the geode's tier, weighted by this table, and resolves the role
# to a type at run time (`geode::prize`). Header in docs/content/schema.md §4.
# `r-nes-econ` §2.6 A had these weights; every value is [A], falsified by a
# week of `[econ-mod] geode` lines whose PLEX or injector totals leave the
# target band (tunables.rs). A role with no row is never drawn; a row of an
# unknown role is skipped with a line. Restart.

column3: [A] the common prize: the materials of 5-20 cycles of some ore
